source_dir.description: The source directory or file path containing plaintext data to be encrypted.

dest_dir.description: The destination directory or file path where encrypted data will be stored.

keys_dir.description: The directory where symmetric key files for each encrypted file are stored.

public_key_path.description: Path to the X509 certificate or PEM private key file used to encrypt the symmetric file keys.

trim_level.description: Number of leading directory components from the source path to trim when creating the destination path.

name_encrypt_map.description: Path to the translation file for encrypted file names. If empty, file names are not encrypted.

ne_nesting.description: Number of subdirectory levels to nest encrypted file names into. Only used if name_encrypt_map is set.

recurse.description: Whether to recursively encrypt/decrypt the entire source directory.

check_changed.description: Whether to check source and destination modification times before processing.

modify_window.description: Time difference in seconds considered 'equal' for modification times. Used with check_changed.

no_archive.description: Do not preserve timestamps. Incompatible with check_changed.

gzip_path.description: Path to a gzip binary that supports --rsyncable. Empty uses system default.

delete.description: Delete files in the destination that do not exist in the source.

delete_keys.description: Also delete symmetric key files when deleting source files. Implies delete.

key_bits.description: Block cipher key size in bits (128, 192, or 256 for AES).

verbose_count.description: Verbosity level. 0 is quiet, increase this number for more verbose output.

export_changes_log.description: Path to a log file where changed filenames are written for use with rsync.

mode.description: Operating mode: 'recursive' for directory trees, 'file' for single file/filelist processing.
